replies.q: Tell me about your present state, in your own words.

replies.q: What is going on inside you at this moment?

replies.q: What is your inner weather like right now?

replies.q: How are things for you at the moment, honestly?

replies.q: What is going on inside you at this moment?

replies.q: Describe what it is like to be you right now.

replies.q: Tell me about your present state, in your own words.
